findings.problem: The lexical outside-repository guard accepts an output whose existing parent symlink resolves into the repository.
findings.reproducer: Create an owned temporary directory outside the repository, add repository-alias pointing at the candidate repository, and evaluate the existing guard on repository-alias/peer-review-not-written.json. Resolve only the parent for comparison. Remove the temporary alias afterward.
findings.interpretation: A mismatch with the declared artifact-location contract. This is not a native-isolation leak or an observed failure of the fixed RUNNER_TEMP workflow path.
findings.requiredRepair: Resolve the existing raw output parent and repository canonically before any verifier attempt. Reject a parent within the repository, unresolved parents and existing/dangling leaf entries. Keep exclusive creation and state trusted-parent race limits.

reviewedBoundaries: Fixed read-only host paths, per-file byte ceilings, safe field allowlists and path-free error codes.
Missing, denied or malformed fields remain UNAVAILABLE. Profile-file presence remains distinct from loaded or attached policy and parent state is not worker state.
The fixed executable is hashed through one read-only O_NOFOLLOW handle with before/after file identity checks. This is not binary authenticity or loaded-memory attestation.
Build failures, skipped/cancelled/unknown outcomes and dirty/unavailable source suppress the native verifier. Existing preinstalled binary presence cannot override the build gate.
Successful clean-source operation launches only the unchanged fixed native verifier once. The existing six case identities and PASS exit-code contract remain.
Context cannot promote a native BLOCKED or FAIL. Source/dependency changes fail evidence separately. All output earns zero product credit.
Stdout/stderr retained bytes and native-verifier deadline are bounded. Timeout or overflow requests SIGKILL only for the owned verifier, waits for its close event and never becomes PASS.
Ubuntu24 retains its original display name, pinned dependency build and warning-only BLOCKED job handling. Ubuntu26 is an independent matrix row with fail-fast disabled.
The uploaded host artifact name remains outside release-* and preserves per-host/per-attempt identity.
The original nine diagnostic test bodies remain byte-for-byte as the original file prefix.

The corrected CLI output preparation rejects the reproduced static alias and resolution failures before source collection or any verifier attempt. Exclusive held-file writes preserve identity and expose failure state without unsafe cleanup.

primarySourcesChecked.finding: The standard x64 table includes both ubuntu-24.04 and ubuntu-26.04.
The published bwrap-userns-restrict change supports a host-default comparison hypothesis, not attribution of any captured PanelReply failure.

limits: No native namespace verification occurred during this review.
The original Ubuntu24 failure remains unresolved. Later-host documentation or a later pass does not repair or establish its cause.
The wrapper timer requests termination. Final evidence waits for the owned process close event, within the existing CI job timeout.
Canonical checks require a trusted parent. They are not an atomic filesystem boundary against concurrent directory renames or replacement.
The 29-case v1 verification and the 40-case v2 verification apply to their separate recorded source hashes. They are not combined as product credit.
No root or candidate source file was edited during this independent review.

outputBoundaryReview.supportedBoundary: Trusted CI output directory that neither contains nor is contained by the repository. Concurrent parent mutation is detected at checkpoints, not atomically excluded.
outputBoundaryReview.residualFailureStates: Creation through a raced parent can leave an empty entry. Moving a held inode during writing may fail the post-write check after bytes were written. Such failures never return completed evidence and do not delete an ambiguous pathname.
